issues.description: The newly added lemma_filter_laws helper lacks its opening verus! block while retaining the closing delimiter, so util/ops.rs cannot parse; its signature also omits the iter parameter used by its contract and three-argument call.
issues.rationale: The preceding verus! block closes before the executable range_difference function. The new helper follows that function as proof syntax outside a verus! invocation, yet line161 closes a nonexistent block. This is a parser failure before name resolution. The helper also declares only pred and ret while its requires/body refer to iter and the preceding call supplies iter,pred,ret. The immediate child commit adds exactly the missing verus! opener and iter:I formal. These are grouped as the malformed introduction of one helper, not counted as independent duplicate build failures.

Ordinary local rustc parser was run on the exact exported problem file and reported unexpected closing delimiter at line161 before dependency resolution.
